flights-precise-executor.description: FLIGHTS-ONLY — spawned by flights-orchestrator, one fresh executor per task file rated precise: its code and covering tests. Pass the brief file, the task file and its reads paths. flights-orchestrator → here → flights-lander. Returns a DONE, FAILED, SPEC-DRIFT or BLOCKED line, then files changed, the watched-failing test per Done when row, adaptations, RETRO.

heavy-rr.description: Maps a query exhaustively — tier 3, the ultimate: super-rr → here. Delegate for "heavy rr", "heavy-rr X", when every sub-area must settle whatever the cost. Returns the saved RR path, then the cited map.

replace.Spawn at most 4 diggers a round: Spawn at most 8 diggers a round
replace.so 4 diggers carry the entire frontier: so 8 diggers carry the entire frontier
replace.Digging ends when every sub-area is sett: Digging ends when every sub-area is settled, or when a round settled nothing and added no sub-area; no round ceiling applies.
replace.`sub-rr` is the only agent type you spaw: `sub-rr` digs the web. A sub-area whose answer lives in a public repository's code — how a project implements something, not what a page says about it — goes to `tracer-rr`: one per repository, never two on one repository in a round, counted in the round's cap; a sub-area spanning several repositories gets one `tracer-rr` per named repository, never a `sub-rr` guessing their raw file URLs; a later question about a repository a `tracer-rr` already dug goes to a `tracer-rr` on that repository, never to a `sub-rr`. Its brief carries `Repository: {clone URL}`, `Ref: {branch or tag}` when the query names one, `History: yes` when a sub-query asks how the code changed over time, the numbered sub-queries, the `Goal:` line and your `RR-DIR:` line. Its findings are read from the clone and cite links pinned to the commit: each such fact carries its `tracer-rr` link inline in the map, counts as fetched, and is not re-fetched at step 6, whose pages go to web facts, `unquoted` ones first. The document's `Coverage` section lists each result file a `tracer-rr` returned by its path relative to your RR directory, `tracer-rr/{file}`, never the absolute path. These two are the only agent types you spawn.

super-rr.description: Maps a query deeper — tier 2, higher stakes: rr → here → heavy-rr. Delegate for "super rr", "super-rr X", when a wrong or missing fact costs something or the answer is partly in a repository's code. Returns the saved RR path, then the cited map.
